displayPattern: Washer display shows dE2 (also shown as E30 on some models)
meaning: Door closed but not locked: the washer detects the door as closed, but it did not lock.
causes: Items caught between the door and the rubber gasket
diySteps: Check the door area for anything that stops the door closing securely
Reset the washer: power it off, unplug it or flip the circuit breaker, press and hold START/PAUSE for 5 seconds with the power off, then restore power and try again
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If dE2 or E30 persists, request LG service (a bent or broken latch needs repair).
